newsitem.title: CHINA: China National Metals revenue $4.9 bln in 1996.
newsitem.headline: China National Metals revenue $4.9 bln in 1996.

text.p: State-run China National Metals and Minerals Import and Export Corp had turnover of more than $4.9 billion in 1996, the International Business Daily said on Monday.
It gave no comparative figures, although it said combined imports and exports were $2.6 billion in a difficult year. There was no breakdown of imports and exports.
China National lowered production costs and adjusted its product mix to deal with a slumping industry, the newspaper said, without giving further details.
